english.note: Use this when emphasizing someone who is just beginning to learn a subject or skill.
Use this for a learner who is at the beginner stage rather than an experienced learner.

examples.english: This book is perfect for a beginner.
examples.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 ngaam1 saai3 co1 hok6 ze2

examples.english: This course is great for a learner at the beginner level.
